segments.normalizedSource: **Objective-C**:

```objc - (id<MTLTexture>)loadTextureUsingMetalKit: (NSURL *) url device: (id<MTLDevice>) device { NSError *error; MTKTextureLoader *loader = [[MTKTextureLoader alloc] initWithDevice: device]; id<MTLTexture> texture = [loader newTextureWithContentsOfURL:url options:nil error:&error]; if(!texture) { NSLog(@"Error creating the texture from %@: %@", url.absoluteString, error.localizedDescription); return nil; } return texture; } ```
